title: DrawNstuff
description: This mod adds markers that are dyeable like leather armor and can draw individual pixels.
body:
# DrawNstuff 
## Description
DrawNstuff is a mod that adds markers to the game simple as that. All you need to do is craft a marker and then slap some dyes on it and you are ready to go.
## Info
- To craft a marker it is a stick with a string on top. 
- To color the marker you just put it in a crafting table with dyes.
- Right click to set up a drawable area then right click to draw on it.
- Shift rightclick to erase.

For more info veiw this yt video: https://youtu.be/hs0iA946dKg
